body:
Dire Fox CR 1

This fox is much larger than others of its kind, it keeps a watchful eye as you pass, trying to determine if you would be good food.

XP 400
N Small animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +2 natural, +1 size)
hp 13 (2d8+4)
Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +3

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., burrow 10 ft.
Melee bite +4 (1d4+1 plus trip)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 15, Con 15, Int 2, Wis 16, Cha 6
Base Attack +1; CMB +1; CMD 13 (17 vs. trip)
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +2 (+6 when jumping), Perception +7, Stealth +10, Survival +1 (+5 scent tracking); Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics when jumping, +4 Survival when tracking by scent

ECOLOGY

Environment forested areas
Organization solitary, pair, or skulk (1-2 with 4-6 normal foxes)
Treasure none

Dire foxes are the larger kin to base foxes. They grow much larger in size and as such pose a greater threat to larger prey. The stats above are for red or gray dire foxes, arctic dire foxes gain an additional +4 to Stealth checks in snowy environments.
